description: For finite propositional premises and a conclusion, valuations agreeing on their combined atom support either both are countervaluations or neither is.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.countervaluation_congr.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α)) (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α)
  (v w : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Valuation α)
  (h : ∀ a ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.contextAtoms Γ ∪ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.atoms A, v a = w a) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Countervaluation v Γ A ↔ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Countervaluation w Γ A
